# AWS X-Ray

Store trace segments, retrieve trace summaries and computed service graphs, and manage groups and sampling rules.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `xray` |
| Signing name | `xray` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2016-04-12` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Trace and configuration records; local graph computation |
| Selected operations | 19 of 38 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-x-ray) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No UDP daemon on port 2000, new listener, Insights, encryption configuration, resource policies or external trace processing.
- Only the documented filter subset is implemented; no NOT, comparisons other than the listed = and > predicates, root-cause analytics, histograms, group-scoped graphs or advanced sampling strategies. Unsupported API members are rejected by the profile.
- Telemetry records are validated and discarded; GetSamplingStatisticSummaries, adaptive sampling, sampling boosts and distributed reservoir allocation are not implemented.
- The built-in Default sampling rule cannot be deleted; deletion attempts reject with InvalidRequestException.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
